ideas.name: Funding Settlement Spot Spread
ideas.claim: Cryptocurrency spot quoted spreads are wider around perpetual futures funding times within the eight-hour funding cycle.
ideas.quote: Market makers respond to heightened adverse selection risk by widening quoted spreads.
ideas.mechanism: Funding settlement is associated with increased informed trading and wider spot bid-ask spreads.

rules.timeframe: Eight-hour perpetual funding cycle; hourly observations

ideas.claimed_result: Spot trading volume and percentage quoted spreads are larger around funding times than during normal hours.
required_data: Cryptocurrency spot bid and ask quotes
